svg.title: L3 Dash - pin ladder
svg.text: One block per housing, one row per cavity. Every wire runs straight from its cavity to where it lands. Read left to right.
L3-P-1 · 12 AWG RED · RT14 · capped at the far end
L3-BLW 1 — the blower receptacle at the HVAC case (DTP-2), dust-capped; no motor this build (K-023 ·
L3-P-2 · 12 AWG RED · RT11 · capped at the far end
L3-CMF 1 — the comfort-bus receptacle behind the centre stack, dust-capped; the luxury package's
Head unit red (ACC) wire; USB-C module +
L3-BLW-1 · 12 AWG RED · RT14 · capped at the far end
Dust-capped receptacle at the HVAC case — the replacement motor plugs in with the luxury package
L3-BLW-2 · 12 AWG BLK · RT14 · capped at the far end
Return to the dash ground, 12 AWG (G15) — the low-side final stage (≥ 20 kHz, its own freewheel
diode) plugs in here as an adapter between receptacle and motor (D-257)
Ignition switch: ACC → 33 kΩ · IG → 15 kΩ · ST → 6.8 kΩ, all summed onto this wire
Light switch E-01: PARK → 33 kΩ · HEAD → 15 kΩ · DIMMER-HI → 8.2 kΩ (fed from the HEAD side) · PASS
Stalk F-02: LEFT 1.8 kΩ · RIGHT 10 kΩ · OFF 47 kΩ, contacts to column ground
Stalk D-03: HIGH 4.7 kΩ · LOW 10 kΩ · INT 18 kΩ · OFF 47 kΩ · WASH 1.8 kΩ + 1N5819 (band toward the
Pedal switch F-11 through 4.7 kΩ; other terminal → dash ground
Hazard contact through 4.7 kΩ; 47 kΩ baseline to column ground at the switch (D-368) - a break in the
horn/wink branch reads as those never pressed; other terminal → column ground
Spare P084 adjustable plunger switch on the brake pedal, fed from the F3 switch supply branched off
L3-S2 2 in the leg through F24 (D-278, D-412)
Dash illumination lamps E-06, E-07, E-10 (RL) + head unit illumination wire
Wink L switch NC terminal; switch common → dash ground
Wink R switch NC terminal; switch common → dash ground
Horn pad through 8.2 kΩ · wink L NO through 18 kΩ · wink R NO through 33 kΩ — three resistors
Ignition switch B terminal · light switch E-01 common through F24, the inline fuse on the branch
L3-S2-3 · 16 AWG BLU · RT11 · capped at the far end
Terminates in DP-DCU-B, the DT06-12S plug at the DCU in the centre stack (luxury D-362); the panel is
the DCU's faceplate (D-350). The L3-WIN console receptacle is deleted - the switch pack moved to the
centre panel with every other key
L3-S2-4 · 16 AWG BLU · RT11 · capped at the far end
Terminates in DP-DCU-B, the DT06-12S plug at the DCU in the centre stack (luxury D-362); the panel is
the DCU's faceplate (D-350). The L3-WIN console receptacle is deleted - the switch pack moved to the
centre panel with every other key
L3-S2-5 · 16 AWG BLU · RT11 · capped at the far end
Terminates in DP-DCU-B, the DT06-12S plug at the DCU in the centre stack (luxury D-362); the panel is
the DCU's faceplate (D-350). The L3-WIN console receptacle is deleted - the switch pack moved to the
centre panel with every other key
L3-S2-6 · 16 AWG BLU · RT11 · capped at the far end
Terminates in DP-DCU-B, the DT06-12S plug at the DCU in the centre stack (luxury D-362); the panel is
the DCU's faceplate (D-350). The L3-WIN console receptacle is deleted - the switch pack moved to the
centre panel with every other key
Future module +12 V constant (F13, block A,
L3-S2-7 · 16 AWG RED · capped at the far end
L3-MOD 1 — the future-module receptacle behind the dash, dust-capped (D-274)
L3-S2-8 · 16 AWG BLK · capped at the far end
Wiper stalk D-03 WASH contact (same terminal as the WASH ladder leg); contact's other side → column
Glove box lamp H-01 +; lamp − → lid switch H-02 → dash ground
Parking brake switch → brake warning lamp
Parking brake switch C-04 terminal BR (switch body grounds through the lever bracket)
Kick-down switch B-32 at the throttle pedal, one terminal. Ignition-fed off O12 through its own inline
fuse - never off F3, whose 5 A also carries the ignition switch, the light switch and the wake stages
L3-S3-1 · 16 AWG GRY · capped at the far end
L3-RDR 1 — the radar pass-through's dash-end receptacle, dust-capped; linked at the post to L4-S 5
L3-S3-2 · 16 AWG GRY · capped at the far end
L3-RDR 2 — the radar pass-through's dash-end receptacle, dust-capped; linked at the post to L4-S 6
L3-S3-3 · 16 AWG GRY · capped at the far end
L3-RDR 3 — the radar pass-through's dash-end receptacle, dust-capped; linked at the post to L4-S 7
Kick-down switch B-32, other terminal → back to the post, linked there to L4-S2 7. L3-S2 had one free
cavity and this is the second conductor, so it takes the first free L3-S3 position
L3-S3-5 · 16 AWG GRY · RT11 · capped at the far end
Terminates in DP-DCU-B, the DT06-12S plug at the DCU in the centre stack, plugged into the DCU at
E26 (D-360, luxury D-362, D-374); capped at the far end until the luxury package fits the mirrors;
linked at the post to L4-S2 1. Motor stall current is confirm - W-332
L3-S3-6 · 16 AWG GRY · RT11 · capped at the far end
Terminates in DP-DCU-B, the DT06-12S plug at the DCU in the centre stack, plugged into the DCU at
E26 (D-360, luxury D-362, D-374); capped at the far end until the luxury package fits the mirrors;
linked at the post to L4-S2 2. Motor stall current is confirm - W-332
L3-S3-7 · 16 AWG GRY · RT11 · capped at the far end
Terminates in DP-DCU-B, the DT06-12S plug at the DCU in the centre stack, plugged into the DCU at
E26 (D-360, luxury D-362, D-374); capped at the far end until the luxury package fits the mirrors;
linked at the post to L4-S2 4. Motor stall current is confirm - W-332
L3-S3-8 · 16 AWG GRY · RT11 · capped at the far end
Terminates in DP-DCU-B, the DT06-12S plug at the DCU in the centre stack, plugged into the DCU at
E26 (D-360, luxury D-362, D-374); capped at the far end until the luxury package fits the mirrors;
linked at the post to L4-S2 3 and L4-S2 5, spliced there. Motor stall current is confirm - W-332
L3-CMF-1 · 12 AWG RED · capped at the far end
Dust-capped DTP receptacle behind the centre stack — the luxury package's fuse block plugs in
Future module +12 V constant (F13, block A,
L3-MOD-1 · 16 AWG RED · capped at the far end
Dust-capped receptacle behind the dash — live when F13 gets a fuse (D-274)
L3-MOD-2 · 16 AWG BLK · capped at the far end
L3-RDR-1 · 16 AWG GRY · capped at the far end
Dust-capped receptacle behind the dash — the radar head's harness plugs in (D-274)
L3-RDR-2 · 16 AWG GRY · capped at the far end
L3-RDR-3 · 16 AWG GRY · capped at the far end
Solid wire: live. Dashed: run and capped at the far end. A box on a wire is an inline resistor. Generated by rx7.py diagrams - do not edit.
